pick.name: Astro
pick.what: Content-first web framework, static by default
pick.why: Fast SEO-friendly pages, MIT, Claude Code writes it well, free static hosting almost anywhere

alts.name: Framer
alts.what: No-code visual site builder with CMS
alts.why: Wins for visual design without code; Basic USD 10/mo for custom domain
alts.free_limits: Free: framer domain only, 1 GB bandwidth

alts.name: Next.js
alts.why: Wins if marketing site shares components/auth with the app

candidates.name: Webflow
candidates.verdict: Powerful but paid for custom domain

decision: Astro plus an AI coding agent gives a fast, SEO-strong site with no builder lock-in. Choose Framer if you want to hand-design visually and accept a monthly fee, or Next.js if the site must live in the app.
details: Cloudflare acquiring the Astro team (Jan 2026) was seen in search results only; unverified.
